_comment: GCS lifecycle for proton call recordings + transcripts.
matchesPrefix is LOAD-BEARING, not a tidiness detail. gs://lv-playground-genai
is a SHARED bucket -- it also holds bqml/, which belongs to unrelated work. A
rule without the prefix condition applies to the WHOLE bucket and would delete
that data after 90 days. Never remove or widen the prefix.
This is what makes PHONE_RECORDING_RETENTION_DAYS real. retention.py cannot
enforce it (there is no Twilio recording-delete adapter, so a run is a dry
run), and the Twilio-side copies are NOT covered by this rule -- it governs
only the archived copies in this bucket.
